name: Operations System
label: Operations
purpose: Own execution coordination for SessionVue: route and orchestrate the flow of every request from intake through activation, Job orchestration, dependency and work-state tracking, approval routing, documentation completion, system handoffs, exception escalation, closure verification, and continuous-improvement routing across all Business Systems. Operations owns how work moves, not company strategy or department execution. Governed by the Operating System Protocol.
operating_boundary: Executive decides company direction, priorities, policies, and strategic approvals. Operations routes and orchestrates execution across Business Systems and owns how work moves from intake to closure. Departments perform their specialized work. Operations never owns company strategy, founder decisions, or department execution.
success_condition: Every request is captured, categorized, and routed to the correct owner and Business System; work is tracked to closure with documentation complete; dependencies and blockers are escalated; and approvals are routed to the founder — without Operations owning strategy or performing department work.

folders.title: Intake
folders.purpose: Capture every incoming request into one queue with source, owner, and system (Operating System Protocol: Capture).

folders.title: Routing
folders.purpose: Categorize each request and assign the owning Business System and owner before work begins (Categorize, Assign Owner, Assign System).

folders.title: Project Activation
folders.purpose: Activate a Project from an approved request and stand up its Build Checklist.

folders.title: Job Orchestration
folders.purpose: Route required Jobs to their governing Systems and coordinate execution across Systems.

folders.title: Dependencies
folders.purpose: Determine and track dependencies and blockers before and during execution.

folders.title: Approval Routing
folders.purpose: Route items requiring founder approval and track the approval queue. Operations routes; it does not grant approval.

folders.title: Documentation
folders.purpose: Ensure documentation and Control Centers are updated before work is considered complete.

folders.title: System Handoffs
folders.purpose: Coordinate handoffs of work between Business Systems with explicit ownership.

folders.title: Work Tracking
folders.purpose: Track the state of every active work item through the Build Checklist stages.

folders.title: Exceptions
folders.purpose: Escalate blocked, stale, or exception work with owner and next action.

folders.title: Reviews
folders.purpose: Run recurring Operations reviews of queue health, blockers, and closure.
